name: OpenAI Web Search

env_keys.comment: Comparison only; anysearch does not read a key for this provider.

mode.comment: Official guide describes three search patterns by model; model-mediated generation, not raw SDK modes.

notes: Comparison only; no anysearch SDK adapter is claimed.

requires_key.comment: Authenticated Responses API calls use an OpenAI API key.

snippet.comment: Model-mediated cited answers and source metadata are returned, not a contracted raw ranked-result snippet field.

domains.comment: Responses web_search filters allow up to 100 allowed_domains or blocked_domains; legacy Chat Completions search does not have this control.

country.comment: user_location.country accepts a two-letter ISO country code; approximate user location biases search.

language.comment: Reviewed web_search control guide documents no dedicated result-language filter. Prompt language is not equivalent to enforced retrieval language.

date.comment: No typed publication-date range control is documented in the reviewed web_search guide; prompt instructions do not prove enforced filtering.

safe_search.comment: No developer-configurable SafeSearch switch is documented in the reviewed tool guide; model safety behavior is not a search filter.

answer.comment: The model produces a sourced answer with URL citations after web_search.

content.comment: Reasoning tools can open pages and find content for the model; this is not a guaranteed raw full-page export API.

summary.comment: The contracted output is a cited model response, not a per-result summary array. An answer summary must not be confused with page summaries.

highlights.comment: Citation offsets identify spans in generated answer text, not query-relevant source-page highlight excerpts.

news.comment: Official examples search current news via general web_search; no dedicated news-only vertical selector is documented.

native_api.value: Model-hosted web_search; tool cost is not total answer cost or raw search price.

rate_limits.value: Legacy preview rules differ; model availability and limits vary

checked_at.comment: Official public documentation reviewed; no paid API or benchmark run.

capability_basis.comment: SDK availability is separate from native provider capability. Each native feature cell carries its own checked date and evidence.

sdk_support.comment: SDK adapter availability only. See Capability basis for the feature rows; native features do not imply an SDK adapter.

pricing_per_1k.value: web_search $10 / 1K tool calls + search-content tokens at model rates
pricing_per_1k.comment: Units and commitments differ; do not rank these as equivalent flat per-query prices.

lowest_price.basis: Tool calls only; search-content tokens billed at model rates

free_tier_limits.comment: Trial, monthly credits and model-tool promotions are distinct.
